Senses.Note: Family comparison with 'that one' (那箇), the variant forms of 'this one' (者箇 and 這个), 'what is it?' (是什麼), and 'who?' (阿誰). Different referents do not create different senses: fist, whisk, sound, pig, residual 'this,' and entrusted charge all instantiate the same proximal demonstrative function. No master-specific meaning found.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: A proximal demonstrative, literally 'this one,' whose referent is supplied by the immediate words, gesture, or situation.
EvidenceBody: Chan records repeatedly make that ordinary dependency visible in public encounters. Guanghui Yuanlian raises a fist and asks whether the place a visitor came from has 'this'; another raises a whisk and says 'this is form,' then strikes the Chan seat and says 'this is sound.' In the Buddha-and-pig exchange, Buddha points linguistically to a pig being carried past and asks, 'what is this?' (這箇是甚麼); when challenged that an all-knowing buddha should recognize it, he answers, 'it still had to be asked' (也須問過). The phrase also points to an unspoken residue in the repeated exchange 'there is still this' / 'what is this?' (猶有這箇在／這箇是甚麼), and to a charge being handed on when a departing master raises his staff and asks, 'to whom is this entrusted?' (這箇分付阿誰). Prose and address uses show the same grammar: a record says 'set this aside' before its next case, Yuanwu asks whether there is still 'this news,' and a rebuke says the buddha teaching is not 'this reasoning.' The Zen bend is therefore not a special hidden object called 'this': the demonstrative remains grammatically open while gestures, objects, questions, discourse, and succession scenes publicly furnish its referent.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: For 這箇, the stored cases establish this term-specific deployment: A proximal demonstrative, literally 'this one,' whose referent is supplied by the immediate words, gesture, or situation.

Different referents do not create different senses: fist, whisk, sound, pig, residual 'this,' and entrusted charge all instantiate the same proximal demonstrative function. No master-specific meaning found.
